The KU1 textbook model uses an annual turnover exemption threshold of €150,000; current exclusions and graduated rates must be checked for real filings.

In the simplified textbook model, annual turnover exceeds the exemption threshold. The fourth-quarter KU1 base already determined under textbook rules is €140,000 and the rate is 3 per mille. Calculate KU1 and give the year-end entry, later payment and profit effect of each.
questions.correctAnswer: €140,000 × 0.003 = €420. Year end: 7780 420 / 3540 420, profit −€420. Payment: 3540 420 / 2800 420, profit €0. The model does not replace checking current legal exclusions and graduated rates.

A sole proprietor pays €8,130 private income tax, €64.20 KU1 and a previously recorded €3,142 VAT liability by bank. Calculate the effects on profit, cash and equity.
questions.correctAnswer: Profit −€64.20; cash −€11,336.20; equity −€8,194.20 from €8,130 drawings and €64.20 expense. Payment of the VAT liability has no new profit effect.
